definition_en: a plan for achieving something, or a secret and dishonest plot
core_image: 几个人在会议室角落低声交谈，桌上摊着一张利益地图
scene: 几个同事在暗地里密谋夺权。A few colleagues schemed to take over the department.
sceneCN: 这里 scheme 是「密谋；策划」（第 3 个义项）；句意：几个同事密谋接管这个部门。

senses.title: Organized plan
senses.definition: an official or organized plan for achieving something
senses.definitionCN: 为实现某事而制定的正式或有组织的计划
senses.example: The city launched a new recycling scheme.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市启动了一项新的回收计划。
senses.why: The core sense is an arranged outline of action.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是安排好的行动纲要。

senses.title: Secret plot
senses.definition: a secret plan to gain an advantage over others
senses.definitionCN: 为取得对他人优势而制定的秘密计划
senses.example: The scheme was discovered before it began.
senses.exampleCN: 这个阴谋在开始前就被发现了。
senses.why: A private plan turns dark when it harms others.
senses.whyCN: 当计划伤害他人时，私下的计划就变得阴暗。

senses.title: Plot secretly
senses.definition: to make secret plans, often to harm others
senses.definitionCN: 制定秘密计划，常指损害他人
senses.example: They schemed to win the contract.
senses.exampleCN: 他们密谋赢得合同。
senses.why: The noun becomes the act of plotting.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为密谋的动作。

senses.title: System or arrangement
senses.definition: an organized system such as a pension or benefit arrangement
senses.definitionCN: 如养老金或福利安排的有组织体系
senses.example: The pension scheme covers all staff.
senses.exampleCN: 养老金计划覆盖所有员工。
senses.why: A plan for many people becomes an institution.
senses.whyCN: 为许多人制定的计划变成一种制度。

intro.en: Scheme comes from Greek schema, a form or figure, through Latin schema.
intro.cn: scheme 经拉丁语 schema 源自希腊语 schema（形状、图形）。

items.en: Schema meant form, shape, or figure.
items.cn: schema 意为形式、形状或图形。

items.en: Schema meant a figure or a plan.
items.cn: schema 意为图形或计划。

items.en: Scheme entered English as a diagram or outline.
items.cn: scheme 以图表或纲要之义进入英语。

items.en: Scheme gained the sense of a secret plot.
items.cn: scheme 获得阴谋的含义。

items.en: Scheme covers official programmes and private plots.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scheme 兼指官方方案与私下阴谋。

note.en: Scheme is compared with similar spellings and with words for plans and plots.
note.cn: 把 scheme 与形近词以及表示计划和阴谋的词作比较。

entries.definition: a place or unit of action

normalIntro.en: Scheme began as a shape and became a plan drawn to that shape.
normalIntro.cn: scheme 最初指形状，后来指按那个形状画出的计划。

normal.en: A scheme is a plan with a clear outline.
normal.cn: 方案就是有清晰轮廓的计划。

normal.en: A pension scheme is an official plan.
normal.cn: pension scheme 是官方计划。

normal.en: A secret scheme is a plot.
normal.cn: 秘密的方案就是阴谋。

normal.en: To scheme against someone is to plot quietly.
normal.cn: scheme against someone 就是暗中算计某人。

normal.en: Schematic drawings show a plan in simple lines.
normal.cn: schematic 图用简单线条表示方案。

abstract.en: Every scheme is a shape imposed on the future.
abstract.cn: 每个方案都是强加给未来的一种形状。

abstract.en: A plan for everyone and a plot by a few share one word.
abstract.cn: 为众人的计划与少数人的阴谋共用一个词。

abstract.en: Schemes reveal what people want before they say it.
abstract.cn: 计谋在人开口之前就暴露了他们想要什么。

examples.en: The government introduced a training scheme.
examples.cn: 政府推出了一项培训方案。

examples.en: Two managers schemed to remove the director.
examples.cn: 两名经理密谋撤掉主管。

examples.en: Their scheme collapsed when the emails were leaked.
examples.cn: 邮件泄露后，他们的阴谋破产了。

dict_mnemonic.text: scheme 与 schema 同源，本义是「形状、图式」；把未来画成图就是方案，偷偷画的就是阴谋。

root: 源自希腊语 schema（形状、图式），经拉丁语 schema 入英语，核心义「为行动画出的轮廓」。

sensesIntro.en: Scheme means an official plan, a secret plot, to plot, or an organized system.
sensesIntro.cn: scheme 意为正式方案、秘密阴谋、密谋，或有组织的制度。

core.en: An outline drawn for future action.
core.cn: 为未来行动画出的轮廓。

branches.en: A public plan for achieving something.
branches.cn: 为实现某事而制定的公开计划。

branches.en: A hidden plan that harms others.
branches.cn: 损害他人的秘密计划。

branches.en: The act of making secret plans.
branches.cn: 制定秘密计划的动作。

branches.en: A plan that becomes a system for many people.
branches.cn: 成为许多人制度的计划。

branches.en: Public and secret plans share the same outline.
branches.cn: 公开计划与秘密计划共享同一轮廓。

intro.en: Scheme has a family of planners, plotters, and diagrams.
intro.cn: scheme 有规划者、阴谋者与图表构成的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin schema, a form, is the direct source.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 schema（形状）是直接来源。

items.structure: English plural noun and third person form
items.meaningCN: 方案（复数）；密谋（第三人称）

items.exampleCN: 这个阴谋家终于被揭穿了。
各部件以示意图形式显示。
这个养老金计划很优厚。

definition_en: a person who studies a subject deeply, especially at a university
core_image: 一位学者伏在堆满古籍的书桌前，专注地做着批注
scene: 这位学者用十年时间研究古文字。The scholar spent ten years studying ancient scripts.
sceneCN: 这里 scholar 是「学者」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这位学者花了十年研究古文字。

senses.title: Deep researcher
senses.definition: a person who studies a subject deeply, especially at a university
senses.definitionCN: 深入研究某一学科的人，尤指在大学中
senses.example: Scholars still debate the meaning of the text.
senses.exampleCN: 学者们仍在争论这段文字的含义。
senses.why: The core sense is a person devoted to deep study.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是致力于深入研究的人。

senses.title: Prize student
senses.definition: a student who receives money to support study
senses.definitionCN: 获得资助以支持学业的学生
senses.example: She is a scholar at the local college.
senses.exampleCN: 她是当地学院的奖学金学生。
senses.why: Support for study names the student who receives it.
senses.whyCN: 对学业的资助以其获得者的名称来表达。

senses.title: Learned person
senses.definition: a person with great knowledge gained from reading and study
senses.definitionCN: 通过阅读和研究获得渊博知识的人
senses.example: The old scholar knew several ancient languages.
senses.exampleCN: 这位老学者懂好几门古代语言。
senses.why: Deep study becomes a general mark of learning.
senses.whyCN: 深入研究成为博学的普遍标志。

intro.en: Scholar comes from Latin schola, school, through Late Latin scholaris.
intro.cn: scholar 经晚期拉丁语 scholaris 源自拉丁语 schola（学校）。

items.en: Skholē meant leisure used for learning.
items.cn: skholē 意为用于学习的闲暇。

items.en: Schola meant a school or a learned discussion.
items.cn: schola 意为学校或学术讨论。

items.en: Scholaris meant of a school or a student.
items.cn: scholaris 意为学校的或学生的。

items.en: Escoler named a pupil or a learned man.
items.cn: escoler 指学生或有学问的人。

items.en: Scoler meant a student and later a learned person.
items.cn: scoler 指学生，后指博学之人。

items.en: Scholar means a specialist researcher or prize student.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scholar 指专业研究者或奖学金学生。

note.en: Scholar is compared with similar spellings and with words for learned people.
note.cn: 把 scholar 与形近词以及表示有学问之人的词作比较。

entries.definition: a person who studies a subject
a person who thinks deeply about ideas

normalIntro.en: Scholar and school share the same Latin root.
normalIntro.cn: scholar 与 school 共享同一个拉丁词根。

normal.en: Scholar begins like school, because a scholar studies there.
normal.cn: scholar 开头像 school，因为学者在学校研究。

normal.en: A scholar of history studies the past deeply.
normal.cn: a scholar of history 指深入研究历史的学者。

normal.en: A visiting scholar comes to teach and learn for a time.
normal.cn: 访问学者短期来讲学和研究。

normal.en: Scholarship is the money or the learning a scholar gains.
normal.cn: scholarship 既是奖学金也是学者的学问。

normal.en: Scholarly writing is careful and full of sources.
normal.cn: 学术写作严谨且引用丰富。

abstract.en: A scholar turns curiosity into patient work.
abstract.cn: 学者把好奇心变成耐心的研究工作。

abstract.en: The word once meant leisure, because learning needs time.
abstract.cn: 这个词原意指闲暇，因为学习需要时间。

abstract.en: A scholar keeps asking even after an answer is found.
abstract.cn: 即使找到答案，学者仍继续追问。

examples.en: Scholars from many countries attended the conference.
examples.cn: 来自许多国家的学者参加了会议。

examples.en: She became a scholar of ancient languages.
examples.cn: 她成为研究古代语言的学者。

examples.en: The young scholar won a prize for her thesis.
examples.cn: 这位年轻学者因论文获奖。

dict_mnemonic.text: scholar 与 school 同源，学校是学习之地，学者就是长期钻研学问的人。

root: 源自拉丁语 schola（学校、学习），经晚期拉丁语 scholaris 入英语，核心义「长期从事学习与研究的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Scholar means a deep researcher, a student with a scholarship, or a learned person.
sensesIntro.cn: scholar 意为深入研究的学者、获得奖学金的学生，或博学之人。

core.en: A person who gives time to deep study.
core.cn: 把时间投入深入研究的人。

branches.en: The core figure of a specialist researcher.
branches.cn: 专业研究者的核心形象。

branches.en: A student supported by an award.
branches.cn: 获得资助的学生。

branches.en: A person marked by broad learning.
branches.cn: 以广博学识著称的人。

branches.en: Deep research produces a learned reputation.
branches.cn: 深入研究造就博学的声望。

branches.en: Both study seriously, one as a career and one as a student.
branches.cn: 两者都认真治学，一个为职业，一个为学生。

intro.en: Scholar has a family linking learning, schools, and awards.
intro.cn: scholar 有连接学问、学校与奖学金的词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin schola, school, is the root of the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 schola（学校）是该词族的词根。

items.example: The scholar wrote a long book.
items.exampleCN: 这位学者写了一本厚书。
他没受过多少学校教育。

definition_en: money given to support study, or serious academic learning
core_image: 一封录取信旁放着奖学金证书，桌上摊着厚厚的研究笔记
scene: 她凭优异成绩拿到了全额奖学金。She won a full scholarship to study abroad.
sceneCN: 这里 scholarship 是「奖学金」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她获得了出国留学的全额奖学金。

senses.title: Study award
senses.definition: money given to a student to help pay for study
senses.definitionCN: 发给学生以资助学业的钱
senses.example: She applied for a scholarship to study abroad.
senses.exampleCN: 她申请了出国留学奖学金。
senses.why: The core sense is financial support for study.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是对学业的资助。

senses.title: Academic research
senses.definition: serious study and research in a subject
senses.definitionCN: 对某一学科进行的认真学习和研究
senses.example: His scholarship on ancient trade is well known.
senses.exampleCN: 他对古代贸易的研究广为人知。
senses.why: The award and the work share the same name.
senses.whyCN: 奖学金与学术工作共用同一个名称。

senses.title: Depth of learning
senses.definition: the level of knowledge and careful method a person shows
senses.definitionCN: 一个人所展现的知识水平与严谨方法
senses.example: The review praised the book's scholarship.
senses.exampleCN: 评论赞扬了这本书的学术水平。
senses.why: Research activity becomes a quality of the researcher.
senses.whyCN: 研究活动变成研究者的品质。

intro.en: Scholarship is scholar plus -ship, from Latin schola, school.
intro.cn: scholarship 由 scholar 加 -ship 构成，根源是拉丁语 schola（学校）。

items.en: Schola meant a school or learned discussion.
items.cn: schola 意为学校或学术讨论。

items.en: Scholaris meant of a school.
items.cn: scholaris 意为学校的。

items.en: Scoler meant a student or learned man.
items.cn: scoler 指学生或有学问的人。

items.en: Scholarship named the state or work of a scholar.
items.cn: scholarship 指学者的身份或工作。

items.en: Scholarship also names money awarded for study.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scholarship 也指用于资助学业的钱。

note.en: Scholarship is compared with similar forms and with words for study awards and learning.
note.cn: 把 scholarship 与形近形式以及表示奖学金和学问的词作比较。

entries.definition: a grant given to a student

normalIntro.en: Scholarship is what a scholar gets and what a scholar does.
normalIntro.cn: scholarship 既是学者得到的东西，也是学者做的事。

normal.en: Scholar plus ship: the ship carries money and learning.
normal.cn: scholar 加 ship：这艘船载着金钱与学问。

normal.en: A full scholarship pays all the study costs.
normal.cn: 全额奖学金支付全部学习费用。

normal.en: Academic scholarship means serious research work.
normal.cn: academic scholarship 意为严肃的学术研究。

normal.en: Win a scholarship and apply for a scholarship are common phrases.
normal.cn: win a scholarship 和 apply for a scholarship 都是常见搭配。

normal.en: The plural scholarships usually refers to awards.
normal.cn: 复数 scholarships 通常指多笔奖学金。

abstract.en: A scholarship buys time for thought.
abstract.cn: 奖学金为思考买来时间。

abstract.en: Money and learning share one word because each supports the other.
abstract.cn: 金钱与学问共用一个词，因为彼此支撑。

abstract.en: True scholarship outlives the award that funded it.
abstract.cn: 真正的学问比资助它的奖项更长久。

examples.en: The university offers scholarships to top students.
examples.cn: 这所大学为优秀学生提供奖学金。

examples.en: Her scholarship focuses on early medicine.
examples.cn: 她的学术研究聚焦早期医学。

examples.en: The book is admired for its careful scholarship.
examples.cn: 这本书因严谨的学术水平而受赞赏。

dict_mnemonic.text: scholar 加 -ship 构成 scholarship：既有「学者身份与学问」，也有资助学业的「奖学金」。

root: 由 scholar 加 -ship 构成，根源为拉丁语 schola（学校），核心义「与学者身份相关的资助与学问」。

sensesIntro.en: Scholarship means money for study, serious academic research, or depth of learning.
sensesIntro.cn: scholarship 意为奖学金、严肃的学术研究，或学识水平。

core.en: Support and work connected with being a scholar.
core.cn: 与学者身份相关的资助与工作。

branches.en: Money that supports a student's study.
branches.cn: 资助学生学业的钱。

branches.en: The serious research a scholar carries out.
branches.cn: 学者进行的严肃研究。

branches.en: The knowledge and method shown in the work.
branches.cn: 研究工作中展现的知识与方法。

branches.en: An award and research both belong to academic life.
branches.cn: 奖学金与研究都属于学术生活。

branches.en: Research work reveals the depth of learning.
branches.cn: 研究工作体现学识的深度。

intro.en: Scholarship ends the scholar family with -ship.
intro.cn: scholarship 以 -ship 收束 scholar 词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin schola, school, is the shared root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 schola（学校）是共同词根。

items.meaning: a study award or academic work
items.exampleCN: 这笔奖学金改变了她的人生。

items.example: She wrote in a scholarly style.

items.exampleCN: 学业成功对他们很重要。
学校教育塑造了她的职业。

definition_en: the systematic study of the physical world, the knowledge gained from it, or a particular field of such study
core_image: 实验室里，试管排成一列，屏幕上跳动着刚记录的数据
scene: 他翻开课本，想弄明白实验背后的道理。Science explains how the experiment works.
sceneCN: 这里 science 是「科学」（第 1 个义项）；句意：科学解释了实验如何运作。

senses.title: Systematic knowledge
senses.definition: the organized study of the physical world through observation and experiment
senses.definitionCN: 通过观察和实验对物质世界进行的有系统研究
senses.example: Science has changed daily life.
senses.exampleCN: 科学改变了日常生活。
senses.why: The central sense is organized knowledge of nature.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是关于自然的有组织知识。

senses.title: Scientific activity
senses.definition: the work of doing scientific research
senses.definitionCN: 进行科学研究的工作
senses.example: Science needs patience and honesty.
senses.exampleCN: 科学研究需要耐心与诚实。
senses.why: The knowledge sense extends to the activity that produces it.
senses.whyCN: 知识义延伸到产生知识的研究活动。

senses.title: A field of study
senses.definition: a particular branch of systematic study
senses.definitionCN: 系统研究的某个分支
senses.example: She studies computer science.
senses.exampleCN: 她学习计算机科学。
senses.why: A broad method narrows to one named discipline.
senses.whyCN: 宽泛的方法缩小为一个具体学科。

intro.en: Science comes from Latin scientia, knowledge, from scire, to know.
intro.cn: science 源自拉丁语 scientia（知识），来自 scire（知道）。

items.en: Scire meant to know.
items.cn: scire 意为知道。

items.en: Scientia meant knowledge or understanding.
items.cn: scientia 意为知识或理解。

items.en: Science meant knowledge of any kind.
items.cn: science 意为任何类型的知识。

items.en: Science narrowed to knowledge based on observation.
items.cn: science 缩小为基于观察的知识。

items.en: Science now names the study of the natural world.
items.cn: 现代英语中 science 指对自然世界的研究。

note.en: Science is compared with similar-looking words and with words for knowledge and study.
note.cn: 把 science 与形近词以及表示知识与研究的词作比较。

entries.definition: a sense of right and wrong

normalIntro.en: Science is knowledge, scientific is the adjective, and scientist is the person.
normalIntro.cn: science 是知识，scientific 是形容词，scientist 是人。

normal.en: Science fiction mixes science with imagination.
normal.cn: 科幻小说把科学与想象结合。

normal.en: Computer science is the study of computing.
normal.cn: 计算机科学是研究计算的学科。

normal.en: A science lab is where experiments happen.
normal.cn: 科学实验室是做实验的地方。

normal.en: Science and scientist share the same base.
normal.cn: science 与 scientist 同根。

normal.en: The ence ending marks a noun.
normal.cn: ence 结尾提示这是名词。

abstract.en: Science began as knowledge in general, then narrowed to tested knowledge.
abstract.cn: science 起初泛指知识，后来缩小为经过检验的知识。

abstract.en: The word links a method, a body of knowledge, and a field.
abstract.cn: 这个词连接方法、知识体系与学科。

abstract.en: To know is the heart of science.
abstract.cn: 「知道」是 science 的核心。

examples.en: Science has changed daily life.
examples.cn: 科学改变了日常生活。

examples.en: She studies computer science.
examples.cn: 她学习计算机科学。

examples.en: The science of medicine grows fast.
examples.cn: 医学科学发展得很快。

dict_mnemonic.text: science 源自拉丁语 scire（知道），ence 构成名词，所以 science 就是「系统化的知识」。

root: 源自拉丁语 scientia（知识），来自 scire（知道），核心义「经系统研究获得的知识」。

sensesIntro.en: Science means systematic knowledge, the activity of research, or a particular field of study.
sensesIntro.cn: science 意为系统知识、研究活动，或某个学科。

core.en: Knowledge built by observation and testing.
core.cn: 通过观察与检验建立的知识。

branches.en: Organized knowledge of nature.
branches.cn: 关于自然的有组织知识。

branches.en: The work of testing and discovering.
branches.cn: 检验与发现的工作。

branches.en: One named branch such as chemistry.
branches.cn: 像化学这样的具体学科。

branches.en: Knowledge and research depend on each other.
branches.cn: 知识与研究相互依存。

branches.en: Each discipline has its own methods.
branches.cn: 每个学科都有自己的方法。

intro.en: Science forms words for its method, people, and fields.
intro.cn: science 构成表示方法、人物与学科的词汇。

latinIntro.en: Latin scientia and scire are the sources.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 scientia 与 scire 是词源。

items.exampleCN: 这所学校教授多门科学。
科学家们分享研究结果。
这个说法经过了科学检验。
计算机科学吸引许多学生。

items.meaning: the study of people and society
items.exampleCN: 社会科学研究人类群体。

definition_zh: 范围；机会；观察仪器；仔细查看
definition_en: the range something covers, the chance to do something, a viewing instrument, or to examine something carefully
core_image: 地图上用铅笔圈出的区域，边界线清楚地把范围标出来
scene: 这项研究的范围只包括本地居民。The scope of the study covers only local residents.
sceneCN: 这里 scope 是「范围」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这项研究的范围只包括本地居民。

senses.title: Range of coverage
senses.definition: the range of subjects or things something deals with
senses.definitionCN: 某事物所涉及的主题或事物的范围
senses.example: The question is beyond the scope of this book.
senses.exampleCN: 这个问题超出了本书的范围。
senses.why: The central sense is the boundary of what is included.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是所涵盖内容的边界。

senses.title: Chance to act
senses.definition: the opportunity or freedom to do something
senses.definitionCN: 做某事的机会或自由空间
senses.example: There is scope for improvement.
senses.exampleCN: 还有改进的余地。
senses.why: A range of action becomes a chance within that range.
senses.whyCN: 行动范围变成范围内的机会。

senses.title: A viewing instrument
senses.definition: a device for looking at something, often in compounds
senses.definitionCN: 用于观察某物的装置，常作构词成分
senses.example: The doctor used a scope to see inside.
senses.exampleCN: 医生用内窥镜查看内部。
senses.why: The Greek root meant a watcher, so instruments of sight took the word.
senses.whyCN: 希腊词根意为观看者，因此观察仪器用了这个词。

senses.title: To examine carefully
senses.definition: to look over something to learn about it
senses.definitionCN: 查看某物以了解它
senses.example: They scoped out the new office.
senses.exampleCN: 他们仔细察看了新办公室。
senses.why: The noun of range becomes a verb of surveying.
senses.whyCN: 表示范围的名词转为勘察的动词。

intro.en: Scope comes from Greek skopos, a watcher or target, through Italian scopo.
intro.cn: scope 源自希腊语 skopos（观看者、目标），经意大利语 scopo 进入英语。

items.en: Skopos meant a watcher or a mark to aim at.
items.cn: skopos 意为观看者或瞄准的目标。

items.en: Scopo meant aim or purpose.
items.cn: scopo 意为目标或目的。

items.en: Scope entered English meaning purpose or aim.
items.cn: scope 进入英语时意为目的或目标。

items.en: Scope came to mean the range of a subject.
items.cn: scope 开始表示主题的范围。

items.en: Scope also names viewing instruments and the act of surveying.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scope 还指观察仪器与勘察行为。

note.en: Scope is compared with similar-looking words and with words for range and room.
note.cn: 把 scope 与形近词以及表示范围和余地的词作比较。

entries.definition: a deep spoon, or a news story
a surface that rises or falls
the limits between which something varies
the size or degree of something

normalIntro.en: Scope is the range you can see or reach, and also the instrument that helps you see.
normalIntro.cn: scope 是你能看到或触及的范围，也是帮助观看的仪器。

normal.en: The scope of a study is what it covers.
normal.cn: 研究范围就是它涵盖的内容。

normal.en: Scope for improvement means room to do better.
normal.cn: scope for improvement 意为改进余地。

normal.en: Telescope and microscope both end in scope.
normal.cn: telescope 与 microscope 都以 scope 结尾。

normal.en: To scope out a place is to look it over.
normal.cn: scope out 一个地方就是察看它。

normal.en: Beyond the scope means outside the limits.
normal.cn: beyond the scope 意为超出范围。

abstract.en: The Greek root joins watching with aiming.
abstract.cn: 希腊词根把观看与瞄准连在一起。

abstract.en: What you can see defines what you can do.
abstract.cn: 能看到的范围界定了能行动的范围。

abstract.en: Instruments of sight carry the name of the act of seeing.
abstract.cn: 观察仪器沿用「看」这一动作的名称。

examples.en: The question is beyond the scope of this book.
examples.cn: 这个问题超出了本书的范围。

examples.en: There is scope for improvement.
examples.cn: 还有改进的余地。

examples.en: They scoped out the new office.
examples.cn: 他们仔细察看了新办公室。

dict_mnemonic.text: scope 源自希腊语 skopos（观看者、目标），所以 telescope 是「看远处」，microscope 是「看微小」，scope 本身指「观察范围」。

root: 源自希腊语 skopos（观看者、目标），核心义「目光所及与目标所在的范围」。

sensesIntro.en: Scope means the range covered, the chance to act, a viewing instrument, or the act of examining.
sensesIntro.cn: scope 意为涵盖范围、行动余地、观察仪器，或仔细查看。

core.en: The field that sight or action can reach.
core.cn: 目光或行动能够到达的领域。

branches.en: The limits of what a subject includes.
branches.cn: 某个主题所包含的界限。

branches.en: The freedom to do something within limits.
branches.cn: 在界限内做某事的自由。

branches.en: A device that extends sight.
branches.cn: 延伸视力的装置。

branches.en: The act of looking something over.
branches.cn: 仔细察看某物的行为。

branches.en: A clear range creates a real chance to act.
branches.cn: 清晰的范围创造出真实的行动机会。

intro.en: Scope forms names for instruments of sight and for surveying.
intro.cn: scope 构成表示观察仪器与勘察的词汇。

latinIntro.en: Greek skopos passed through Italian scopo into English.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 skopos 经意大利语 scopo 进入英语。

items.example: Each team scopes its own area.
items.exampleCN: 每个小组察看自己的区域。

items.meaning: surveyed, or fitted with a scope
items.example: The scoped rifle lay on the table.
items.exampleCN: 带瞄准镜的步枪放在桌上。

items.example: Scoping the project took a week.
items.exampleCN: 界定项目范围花了一周。

items.meaning: an instrument for seeing small things
items.example: The cells are visible under a microscope.

items.meaning: an instrument for seeing distant things
items.example: They watched the stars with a telescope.
items.exampleCN: 他们用望远镜观察星星。

items.meaning: a tube for seeing above or around
a tube for seeing inside the body
to examine a place or plan
items.example: We scoped out the route first.

definition_zh: 得分；比分；成绩；二十；配乐
definition_en: the number of points in a game, a mark or result, a group of twenty, or music for a film or play
core_image: 球场大屏幕上的比分牌翻到最后一分，观众全部站起来
scene: 终场哨响，球迷们抬头看大屏幕。The final score was three to two.
sceneCN: 这里 score 是「得分；比分」（第 1 个义项）；句意：最终比分是三比二。

senses.title: Points in a game
senses.definition: the number of points won in a game or competition
senses.definitionCN: 比赛或竞赛中赢得的分数
senses.example: He scored twice in the second half.
senses.exampleCN: 他在下半场进了两个球。
senses.why: The central modern sense is points in a contest.
senses.whyCN: 核心现代义是竞赛中的得分。

senses.title: A mark or result
senses.definition: the result of a test or assessment
senses.definitionCN: 考试或评估的结果
senses.example: Her test score improved.
senses.exampleCN: 她的考试成绩提高了。
senses.why: The game sense extends to any measured result.
senses.whyCN: 比赛义延伸到任何被测量的结果。

senses.title: A group of twenty
senses.definition: a set or group of twenty
senses.definitionCN: 由二十个组成的一组
senses.example: A score of people waited outside.
senses.exampleCN: 二十个人在外面等候。
senses.why: A tally mark for twenty gave the word this counting sense.
senses.whyCN: 表示二十的刻痕计数赋予该词这一数量义。

senses.title: Music for a film
senses.definition: the music written for a film, play, or show
senses.definitionCN: 为电影、戏剧或演出创作的音乐
senses.example: The film score was written in a month.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影的配乐一个月就写好了。
senses.why: A written score is a set of musical marks, like a tally.
senses.whyCN: 乐谱是一组记下的符号，如同刻痕计数。

intro.en: Score comes from Old Norse skor, a notch or tally mark.
intro.cn: score 源自古诺尔斯语 skor（刻痕、计数刻线）。

items.en: Skor meant a notch cut into wood.
items.cn: skor 意为刻在木头上的刻痕。

items.en: Score named a tally kept by notches.
items.cn: score 指用刻痕记录的账目。

items.en: A score of twenty became a standard count.
items.cn: 以二十为一组的计数成为标准。

items.en: Score named the points kept in games.
items.cn: score 开始指比赛中记录的分数。

items.en: Score also means written music for a film or play.
items.cn: 现代英语中 score 还指电影或戏剧的配乐。

note.en: Score is compared with similar-looking words and with words for points and marks.
note.cn: 把 score 与形近词以及表示分数与成绩的词作比较。

entries.definition: a unit of score in a game

normalIntro.en: Score began as a notch used for counting and now names points and music.
normalIntro.cn: score 起初是计数用的刻痕，现在指得分与配乐。

normal.en: The final score decides the winner.
normal.cn: 最终比分决定胜者。

normal.en: A test score measures a result.
normal.cn: 考试分数衡量结果。

normal.en: A score of people means twenty people.
normal.cn: a score of people 指二十个人。

normal.en: A film score is its music.
normal.cn: film score 是电影配乐。

normal.en: To score is to win a point.
normal.cn: to score 就是得分。

abstract.en: Counting by notches connects twenty, games, and music.
abstract.cn: 刻痕计数把二十、比赛与音乐连接起来。

abstract.en: A score is a record of what has been counted.
abstract.cn: score 是被计数内容的记录。

abstract.en: Music on a page is also a kind of tally of sounds.
abstract.cn: 纸上的音乐也是一种声音的记录。

examples.en: The final score was three to two.
examples.cn: 最终比分是三比二。

examples.en: Her test score improved.
examples.cn: 她的考试成绩提高了。

examples.en: The film score won an award.
examples.cn: 这部电影的配乐获了奖。

dict_mnemonic.text: score 源自古诺尔斯语 skor（刻痕），古人用刻痕计数，二十为一组，所以 score 又有「二十」义；比赛记分也来自刻痕计数。

root: 源自古诺尔斯语 skor（刻痕、计数刻线），核心义「用刻痕记录的数量与得分」。

sensesIntro.en: Score means points in a game, a test result, a group of twenty, or music for a film.
sensesIntro.cn: score 意为比赛得分、考试成绩、二十，或电影配乐。

core.en: A record of counting, from notches to points.
core.cn: 从刻痕到得分的计数记录。

branches.en: Points recorded in a contest.
branches.cn: 比赛中记录的分数。

branches.en: A measured result on a test.
branches.cn: 考试中测量的结果。

branches.en: A counted group of twenty.
branches.cn: 计为一组的二十个。

branches.en: Written music for a production.
branches.cn: 为演出写下的音乐。

branches.en: Games and tests both turn performance into numbers.
branches.cn: 比赛与考试都把表现转化为数字。

intro.en: Score forms words for scoring, players, and music marks.
intro.cn: score 构成表示记分、得分者与音乐记号的词汇。

latinIntro.en: Old Norse skor is the source; there is no Latin root.
latinIntro.cn: 古诺尔斯语 skor 是词源，没有拉丁词根。

items.example: Scores rose after the new rules.
items.exampleCN: 新规则实施后分数上升。

items.example: Scoring is easy in this game.

items.meaning: to emphasize or draw a line under

items.exampleCN: 这部电影配乐萦绕人心。

definition_zh: 侦察员；童子军；侦察；物色（人才）
definition_en: a person sent to gather information, a member of a youth group, to search an area, or a talent spotter
core_image: 一名少年趴在树林边，用望远镜观察远处的营地
scene: 侦察员悄悄爬上小山，观察下面的营地。The scout crept up the hill and watched the camp below.
sceneCN: 这里 scout 是「侦察员」（第 1 个义项）；句意：侦察员悄悄爬上小山，观察下面的营地。

senses.title: A person who gathers information
senses.definition: a person sent to observe an area and report what they see
senses.definitionCN: 被派去观察某地并汇报所见的人
senses.example: The scout reported enemy movement.
senses.exampleCN: 侦察员报告了敌军的动向。
senses.why: The core sense is a person sent ahead to watch.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是被派到前方观察的人。

senses.title: A youth group member
senses.definition: a member of a youth organization that teaches outdoor skills
senses.definitionCN: 教授户外技能的青少年组织成员
senses.example: The scout learned to tie knots.
senses.exampleCN: 这名童子军学会了打绳结。
senses.why: The watching and camping skills of scouts became a youth movement.
senses.whyCN: 侦察员的观察与露营技能发展成青少年运动。

senses.title: To search an area
senses.definition: to examine an area in order to find something
senses.definitionCN: 为了寻找某物而查看某个区域
senses.example: They scouted the area for a campsite.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在那片区域寻找营地。
senses.why: The person's task becomes a verb.
senses.whyCN: 侦察员的任务变成动词。

senses.title: A talent spotter
senses.definition: a person who searches for talented people
senses.definitionCN: 寻找有才华者的人
senses.example: A scout offered her a place on the team.
senses.exampleCN: 一名球探给了她队里的位置。
senses.why: Searching a field for players mirrors searching land for information.
senses.whyCN: 在赛场上寻找球员，类似在地区中搜集信息。

intro.en: Scout comes from Old French escouter, to listen, from Latin auscultare.
intro.cn: scout 源自法语 escouter（听），来自拉丁语 auscultare（倾听）。

items.en: Auscultare meant to listen carefully.
items.cn: auscultare 意为仔细倾听。

items.en: Escouter meant to listen or spy.
items.cn: escouter 意为听或打探。

items.en: Scout named a person sent to watch the enemy.
items.cn: scout 指被派去监视敌人的人。

items.en: Scout also named members of a youth movement.
items.cn: scout 也指青少年运动成员。

items.en: Scout now also means to search or to spot talent.
items.cn: 现代英语中 scout 还表示搜寻或物色人才。

note.en: Scout is compared with similar-looking words and with words for watchers and searchers.
note.cn: 把 scout 与形近词以及表示观察者和搜寻者的词作比较。

entries.definition: a person who secretly gathers information
a person who travels to learn about places
a person who watches for something

normalIntro.en: A scout watches, searches, and sometimes finds talent.
normalIntro.cn: scout 既观察、搜寻，也用于物色人才。

normal.en: A scout reports what lies ahead.
normal.cn: 侦察员报告前方情况。

normal.en: A scout troop camps outdoors.
normal.cn: 童子军小队在户外露营。

normal.en: A talent scout watches young players.
normal.cn: 星探观察年轻球员。

normal.en: To scout an area is to search it.
normal.cn: scout 一片区域就是搜寻它。

normal.en: Scout and shouting share a sound but not a meaning.
normal.cn: scout 与 shouting 发音相近，意义不同。

abstract.en: The word begins with listening, not looking.
abstract.cn: 这个词最初与听有关，而不是看。

abstract.en: Watching ahead and finding talent are both forms of search.
abstract.cn: 向前观察与发现人才都是搜寻的形式。

abstract.en: A scout turns curiosity into a job.
abstract.cn: 侦察员把好奇心变成职业。

examples.en: The scout reported enemy movement.
examples.cn: 侦察员报告了敌军的动向。

examples.en: A talent scout saw her sing.
examples.cn: 一位星探看到了她唱歌。

examples.en: They scouted the area for a campsite.
examples.cn: 他们在那片区域寻找营地。

root: 源自古法语 escouter（听），来自拉丁语 auscultare（倾听），核心义「暗中观察与打探」。

sensesIntro.en: Scout means a person who gathers information, a youth member, to search an area, or a talent spotter.
sensesIntro.cn: scout 意为搜集信息的人、童子军成员、侦察搜寻，或人才物色者。

core.en: A person who watches ahead and reports.
core.cn: 在前方观察并汇报的人。

branches.en: A soldier or watcher sent ahead.
branches.cn: 被派到前方的士兵或观察者。

branches.en: A young member of an outdoor group.
branches.cn: 户外青少年组织的成员。

branches.en: The act of searching a place.
branches.cn: 搜寻某个地方的行为。

branches.en: A person who finds talented players.
branches.cn: 发现有才华球员的人。

branches.cn: 人物与搜寻共享同一个概念。

intro.en: Scout forms words for youth groups, searching, and talent work.
intro.cn: scout 构成表示青少年团体、搜寻与人才工作的词汇。

latinIntro.en: Latin auscultare, to listen, is the distant source.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 auscultare（倾听）是远源。

items.example: They scout new players each year.

items.exampleCN: 童子军活动教授户外技能。

items.meaning: a leader of a scout troop

items.example: The talent scout watched the match.

definition_en: to rub a hard edge against a surface, to wound the skin, to barely succeed, or to gather with effort
core_image: 勺子贴着锅底刮过，留下一圈亮亮的痕迹
scene: 他不小心把膝盖擦伤了。He accidentally scraped his knee.
sceneCN: 这里 scrape 是「擦伤」（第 2 个义项）；句意：他不小心把膝盖擦伤了。

senses.title: To rub against a surface
senses.definition: to rub something hard against a surface
senses.definitionCN: 使某物用力摩擦表面
senses.example: She scraped the paint off the door.
senses.exampleCN: 她把门上的漆刮掉了。
senses.why: The core sense is harsh rubbing that removes a layer.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是摩擦表面并带走一层。

senses.title: To wound the skin
senses.definition: to damage the skin by rubbing it against something rough
senses.definitionCN: 因摩擦粗糙表面而伤到皮肤
senses.example: He accidentally scraped his knee.
senses.exampleCN: 他不小心把膝盖擦伤了。
senses.why: The rubbing action becomes a small injury.
senses.whyCN: 摩擦动作变成一种小伤。

senses.title: To barely succeed
senses.definition: to succeed by a very small margin
senses.definitionCN: 以极小差距成功
senses.example: He scraped through the test.
senses.exampleCN: 他勉强通过了考试。
senses.why: Passing by a scrape is passing by a narrow margin.
senses.whyCN: 「擦着边通过」就是以极小差距通过。

senses.title: To gather with effort
senses.definition: to collect something with difficulty
senses.definitionCN: 困难地收集某物
senses.example: They scraped together enough money.
senses.exampleCN: 他们凑齐了足够的钱。
senses.why: Scraping the last bits together means gathering what is left.
senses.whyCN: 刮拢最后一点，就是收集剩余之物。

intro.en: Scrape probably comes from Old Norse skrapa, to scratch or scrape.
intro.cn: scrape 可能源自古诺尔斯语 skrapa（刮、擦）。

items.en: Skrapa meant to scratch or scrape a surface.
items.cn: skrapa 意为刮擦表面。

items.en: Scrapen meant to remove something by rubbing.
items.cn: scrapen 意为通过摩擦去除某物。

items.en: Scrape also meant to scratch the skin.
items.cn: scrape 也开始表示擦伤皮肤。

items.en: Scraping together meant collecting with difficulty.
items.cn: scrape together 意为艰难地凑集。

items.en: Scrape through means to pass by a narrow margin.
items.cn: scrape through 意为勉强通过。

note.en: Scrape is compared with similar-looking words and with verbs for rubbing and scratching.
note.cn: 把 scrape 与形近词以及表示摩擦和刮擦的动词作比较。

entries.definition: to rub hard in order to clean
to mark a surface with a sharp point
to move with pressure over a surface
to break the skin by rubbing

normalIntro.en: Scrape is hard rubbing, and it also names a narrow escape.
normalIntro.cn: scrape 是用力摩擦，也指勉强过关。

normal.en: Scrape the pan to get the last bits.
normal.cn: 刮锅底以取得最后一点食物。

normal.en: Scrape a knee on rough ground.
normal.cn: 在粗糙地面擦伤膝盖。

normal.en: Scrape through means barely pass.
normal.cn: scrape through 意为勉强通过。

normal.en: Scrape together means collect with effort.
normal.cn: scrape together 意为费力凑集。

normal.en: A scraper is a tool for scraping.
normal.cn: scraper 是刮擦工具。

abstract.en: The word is about surfaces and what lies just beneath them.
abstract.cn: 这个词关涉表面以及表面之下的一层。

abstract.en: A narrow pass is like a near miss that still touches.
abstract.cn: 勉强通过就像擦着边的险胜。

senses.title: From the very beginning

definition_en: to give a loud high cry, to shout very loudly, or such a cry
core_image: 过山车俯冲而下，乘客闭着眼张嘴尖叫
scene: 过山车俯冲时，她忍不住尖叫。She could not help screaming as the roller coaster dived.

senses.title: A cry of fear or pain
senses.definition: to give a loud high cry because of fear, pain, or surprise
senses.definitionCN: 因恐惧、疼痛或惊讶而发出响亮高亢的叫声
senses.example: She screamed when she saw the spider.

senses.title: To shout very loudly

senses.definitionCN: 以极高音量说话或呼喊

senses.exampleCN: 人群高兴地大喊。
senses.why: The cry of feeling extends to any very loud call.

senses.title: A high sharp sound

definition_zh: 屏幕；银幕；屏风；筛查；遮挡
definition_en: a flat surface showing images, the cinema, a protective panel, to examine for suitability, or to hide something

senses.title: A display surface

senses.definitionCN: 显示图像或文字的平面
senses.example: The phone screen lit up in the dark room.
senses.exampleCN: 手机屏幕在黑暗的房间里亮了起来。
